svg.title: Ottopus Ink: every crypto move, one ask away
svg.desc: Ottopus Ink's hero, under water. Ask the agent on your own computer to pay, swap or send; NEAR Intents finds the route across chains, and nothing moves until you sign. A chat with Claude Code pays an invoice of 250 USDC on Base from two balances, 180 from NEAR Intents and 70 from Solana, after it is approved in the review window.

text.tspan: Ask the agent on your own computer to pay, swap
or send. NEAR Intents finds the route across chains,
and nothing moves until you sign.

g.text: RUNS ON THE AGENT YOU ALREADY USE
Ask for it. Sign it yourself.
Waiting for you in the review window
Approved · two parts on their way
